title: Effect of Laser Power Welding on the Characteristics of P20 Stainless Steel Clads for Mold Tools Repair
content: In the plastic industry, steels such as P20, H13, or AISI 1018 are widely used as mold materials due to their well-established reputation for exhibiting moderate mechanical strength, which is crucial for effective manufacturing [1]. These specific materials are carefully chosen because they are durable enough to withstand the demanding rigors of molding processes while maintaining crucial dimensional stability and structural integrity. These characteristics are essential factors that contribute significantly to ensuring the production of high-quality plastic components that can meet industry standards and customer expectations.
